seite.aus: The tip of the day is switched off. You can switch it on under My account → Appearance.

konto.tipps.hilfe: At most one a day: a dot on the assistant at the bottom right shows it, and it is under “Tips”. All tips are under “Discover Ablago”.
fuehrung.ueberspringen.titel: End the tour – it will not appear again by itself
fuehrung.spaeter.titel: Close now and offer it again the next time you sign in
bild.titel: Simplified picture of Ablago: views on the left, the list in the middle, the open folder on the right.
bild.titel-handy: Simplified picture of Ablago on a phone: the view at the top, the list below it.
rundgang.ablago.beschreibung: The most important places in your Library – in one minute.
rundgang.ablago.ende: Now and then Ablago shows you a short tip on the start page. You will find all tips and this tour under your name in “Discover Ablago”.
rundgang.ablago.dreiteilung.text: On the left you choose a view, in the middle you see the list, and the folder opens on the right. A folder holds everything about one thing.
rundgang.ablago.dreiteilung.text-handy: On a phone everything is stacked: at the top you choose the view, below it you see the list. Tap a folder to open it.
rundgang.ablago.neu.text: Use “+ New” to file post, for example a scanned letter. It waits in “New post” until you assign it to a folder.
rundgang.ablago.neu.ort: The “+ New” button is at the top, in the header.
rundgang.ablago.suche.text: Type a name, a number or a word at the top and press Enter: the advanced search shows all hits. The / key takes you here from any page.
rundgang.ablago.suche.ort: The search box is at the top, in the header.
rundgang.ablago.erledigen.text: “To do” lists what is coming up: tasks, reminders and deadlines. Ablago reminds you in good time, for example before a notice period ends.
rundgang.ablago.erledigen.ort: “To do” is on the left with the views; on a phone it is a tile on the start page.
rundgang.ablago.konto.text: Under your name you will find “My account” with password, font size and absence. “Discover Ablago” is there too.
rundgang.ablago.konto.text-verwalten: Under your name you will find “My account” and “Discover Ablago”. With “Administer Ablago” you set Ablago up for everyone.
rundgang.ablago.konto.ort: The button with your name is at the top right and opens the user menu.
tipp.suche-in-dokumenten: In a view, “Search in” on the search box at the top lets the search include the text of your letters and invoices.
tipp.favoriten: Use the star in a folder to keep it handy. You will then find it on the left under “Favourites”.
tipp.zu-erledigen-monat: In “To do”, “Month” shows all deadlines and reminders like a calendar.
tipp.neue-post-zuordnen: Click a letter in “New post”: the document in the middle, on the right you choose where it belongs – new folder (prefilled), existing one or just done.
tipp.schriftgroesse: Is the text too small? Under “My account” → “Appearance” you can make it bigger.
tipp.archivnummer: Is there an archive number on a paper? Type it into the search box at the top and press Enter to open exactly that document.
tipp.post-ablegen: Use “+ New” to file post. On a phone you can photograph a letter straight away with the camera.
tipp.frag-deine-ablage: In the assistant at the bottom right, “Ask” takes a question in full sentences, for example: When does the phone contract end?
tipp.fragen-oder-suchen: Ask questions in the assistant at the bottom right and search in the box at the top – Enter there shows all hits.
tipp.erinnern: In any folder, choose “Folder ▾” → “Remind” to set a date. Ablago then lets you know in “To do”.
tipp.abwesenheit: Away for a while? Enter your stand-in under “Absence” – new tasks then go to that person.
tipp.erweiterte-suche: With the advanced search you can find, for example, all invoices that have not been paid yet.
tipp.zusammenfassung: With the Daily summary you get an email each morning with everything that is coming up for you.
tipp.startseite-kachel: Under “My account” → “Appearance” you choose which view appears as the fourth tile on your start page.
tipp.laufwerk: You can connect your Library to your computer as a drive. Under your name, “Connect as a drive” explains how.
tipp.rundgang: Would you like to see the short tour of Ablago again? It only takes a minute.
tipp.pakete: Ready-made folder types, for example for contracts or insurance, come as packages. You find them via “Administer Ablago” under “Packages”.
tipp.benutzer-einladen: Under “Administer Ablago” → “Users” you invite more people. Each of them gets their own account.
tipp.sicherung: Now and then, check under “Administer Ablago” → “Backup” when Ablago last backed everything up.
